issue.title: Semgrep MCP OAuth fails with invalid_target (resource parameter rejected)
issue.body:
### What happened

Adding the hosted Semgrep MCP server (`https://mcp.semgrep.ai/mcp`) and clicking **Sign in** never completes. The browser ends on magpie's local callback with `error=invalid_target`, and magpie shows:

> Magpie couldn't finish the sign-in: the token endpoint answered 400: invalid_target

### Environment

- magpie 0.1.1311, Windows 11 26H2 (build 26300.9711)
- MCP server: `semgrep` → `https://mcp.semgrep.ai/mcp` (HTTP, OAuth)
- Semgrep protected-resource metadata (`https://mcp.semgrep.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`):

  ```json
  {"resource":"https://mcp.semgrep.ai/","authorization_servers":["https://login.semgrep.dev/"],"scopes_supported":[],"bearer_methods_supported":["header"]}
  ```

- Authorization-server metadata: `https://login.semgrep.dev/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

### Steps to reproduce

1. Library → MCP servers → `semgrep` → **Sign in**.
2. magpie opens an authorize URL of the form:
   `https://login.semgrep.dev/oauth2/authorize?...&resource=https%3A%2F%2Fmcp.semgrep.ai%2F&...`
3. The browser is redirected to `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback?error=invalid_target&state=...`.
4. Even after completing the Semgrep login with the `resource` parameter removed from the authorize URL, magpie's callback still reports `the token endpoint answered 400: invalid_target`.

### Evidence that the `resource` parameter is the trigger

- Requesting the same authorize URL **with** `resource=https://mcp.semgrep.ai/` returns an immediate `invalid_target` redirect.
- Requesting the same URL **without** the `resource` parameter reaches the normal Semgrep login page (`https://semgrep.dev/login?return_path=...`).
- The token request also fails with `invalid_target`, so the parameter is being sent at both the authorize and token stages.
- The refresh path fails the same way (`the token endpoint answered 400: invalid_target`), so this is not only an initial-exchange problem.

### Expected

Sign-in completes and the token is stored, or magpie retries without `resource` when the authorization server rejects it.

### Suggested fix

Treat `invalid_target` as a signal to retry without the RFC 8707 `resource` parameter (at authorize, token, and refresh), or make `resource` opt-in per server. Semgrep's protected-resource metadata advertises a resource, but its authorization server does not accept the parameter.

### Workaround

Remove the server from the agent's MCP config, or use a local `semgrep-mcp` stdio server with `SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN`.

comments.body:
Fixed the token stage (#3194), in a limited scope, in commit 109e6f47a18cd0540e463089ac9d86656840dac5 on the fix/r25-mcp-invalid-target-retry branch.

**What was wrong.** An authorization server that advertises a resource in its protected-resource metadata may still answer 400 invalid_target to a token request that carries that resource (Semgrep's does). Because the code exchange and every renewal send the resource, the sign-in failed there — the stage after the browser, where the error text could not be acted on.

**What changed (root fix, shared layer).** `tokenRequest` in `internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go` now posts the form once and, only when the answer is `invalid_target` and the form carried a `resource` parameter, sends it again without that parameter. Everything else about the request goes as it was — the PKCE verifier, the client authentication, the grant — and the saved record keeps the resource the server advertised (only its token stage refused it). No other token-endpoint error is retried, and a request without a resource is never retried, so there is no loop; a server that keeps refusing gets exactly one retry.

**Scope, stated plainly — this is a partial fix.** The rejection at the authorize stage (the browser being sent back with `error=invalid_target` before any token exists) is **not** fixed here: that is browser-side, and this change deliberately leaves it as it is. A real Semgrep server was not exercised; the fix was verified against a fake authorization server that reproduces the behavior.

**Tests.** `internal/mcpauth/renew_resource_test.go` signs in through the real discovery, registration and loopback callback and covers: the code exchange and a renewal both going on without the unaccepted resource, `invalid_grant` not retried, a record without a resource not retried, a persistent refusal bounded at exactly two token requests, the client secret still sent on the retry, and a cancellation during the held retry saving nothing. The fake's token endpoint counts its requests so the bounds are asserted, not assumed.

**RED/GREEN.** On a `git archive` of the base with only the test files added, the new tests fail with real `invalid_target` failures at the exchange and the renewal (exit 1); with the fix they pass (exit 0). `go test -race` passes for `internal/mcpauth/...` and `internal/library`, and for the MCP-targeted `internal/gateway` tests; `gofmt`, `go vet ./...`, Linux/nogui and Windows `go vet` and builds are clean. The full `-race ./internal/gateway` run has three failures and a 10-minute package timeout that the untouched base has too; this change touches only `internal/mcpauth`.

issue.title: [feat] MCP 自定义 OAuth 应用支持显式配置 scopes（Microsoft Entra ID）

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
使用自己的 OAuth 应用连接受 Microsoft Entra ID 保护的远程 MCP 服务器时，需要请求自定义 API scope。当前 Magpie 的「使用自己的 OAuth 应用」只能配置客户端凭据和回调端口，无法指定 scopes。实际授权请求缺少业务 API scope，登录返回 `invalid_target / AADSTS9010010`。

希望支持为每个 MCP 服务器的自定义 OAuth 应用显式配置 scopes；未配置时保留现有的自动发现行为。

**场景与实际结果**

- 接入方式：HTTP MCP，通过预先注册的 OAuth 应用登录。
- 授权服务器：Microsoft Entra ID 的 OAuth 2.0 v2.0 端点。
- 应用要求以下 scopes。自定义资源标识已替换为示例值，保留 `api://…/UserConnect` 的结构：

```json
[
  "openid",
  "offline_access",
  "api://example-mcp/UserConnect"
]
```

实际从 Magpie 打开的授权 URL 中读取到的请求参数如下。参数已 URL 解码；租户 ID、客户端 ID、企业服务地址、回调端口、PKCE challenge 和 state 均已脱敏：

```text
authorization_endpoint=https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant-id>/oauth2/v2.0/authorize
client_id=<client-id>
response_type=code
redirect_uri=http://localhost:<callback-port>/callback
code_challenge=<redacted>
code_challenge_method=S256
state=<redacted>
resource=https://mcp.example.com/mcp
scope=openid offline_access
```

其中 `scope` 是实际请求中的完整值，缺少应用要求的 `api://example-mcp/UserConnect`。浏览器回调显示：

```text
The sign-in was refused: invalid_target: AADSTS9010010:
The resource parameter provided in the request doesn't match with the requested scopes.
```

**复现步骤**

1. 在资源库中添加受 Entra ID 保护、需要自定义 API scope 的 HTTP MCP 服务器。
2. 选择「使用自己的 OAuth 应用」，填写该应用的 Client ID、Client Secret 和所需的回调端口。
3. 点击登录，检查打开的授权 URL。
4. 在本次实际场景中，授权请求的 `scope` 只有 `openid offline_access`，随后收到上述错误；编辑器没有补充业务 API scope 的入口。

上述请求和错误来自实际登录。下面的源码核查基于 2026-10-23 的 `main` 提交 [`e00fbdbb`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/commit/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4)，不据此推定实际安装版本。

**源码依据**

| 位置 | 当前行为 |
| --- | --- |
| [`internal/library/mcp.go`：`OAuthApp`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/library/mcp.go#L55) | 配置结构只有 `ClientID`、`ClientSecret` 和 `CallbackPort`，没有 scope/scopes 字段。 |
| [`plugins/library/client.js`：`drawApp`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/gui/assets/plugins/library/client.js#L2087) | 编辑器仅提供 Client ID、Client Secret、Callback port 三个输入项。 |
| [`internal/library/mcp_signin.go`：`SignInServer`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/library/mcp_signin.go#L105) | 创建 `mcpauth.App` 时只传递上述三个字段，登录调用链没有传递用户自定义 scopes 的入口。 |
| [`internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go`：发现逻辑](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go#L565) | 优先读取 `WWW-Authenticate` 的 scope；为空时使用受保护资源元数据的 `scopes_supported`。随后通过 [`withOffline`](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go#L652) 按条件追加 `offline_access`，没有用户覆盖入口。 |
| [`internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go`：授权请求](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go#L845) | 将发现得到的 `m.Scope` 写入授权请求，同时携带 `m.Resource`；使用自定义 OAuth 应用也走这条路径。 |

**期望行为**

- 在自定义 OAuth 应用配置中增加可选的 scopes 字段，支持多个 scope，包括完整的自定义 API scope。
- 配置了 scopes 时，将用户指定的集合用于授权请求；未配置时，继续使用现有自动发现逻辑。
- 修改 scopes 后重新登录时，使用更新后的配置。本例期望发送：

```text
scope=openid offline_access api://example-mcp/UserConnect
```

- 补充测试，验证自定义 OAuth 应用能发送指定的 API scope，同时保留未配置 scopes 时的行为。

**与 #3194 的关系及尚待确认的部分**

关联 [#3194](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3194)。该 issue 报告 Semgrep 拒绝 `resource` 参数；本场景同样出现 `invalid_target`，但另有明确的「缺少自定义 scopes 配置能力」需求，因此单独提出，并不认定两个问题根因完全相同。

目前能够确认的是：实际请求没有包含应用要求的业务 API scope，且当前配置和界面无法手动指定它。尚未确认补齐 scope 后登录是否成功，也尚未确认实际请求的 `resource` 是否对应 `UserConnect` 所属的同一个 Entra 资源应用。[微软对 AADSTS9010010 的说明](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/agent-id/secure-mcp-server-with-entra-id#i-get-error-aadsts9010010-when-a-client-requests-a-token-for-my-mcp-server)指出，资源标识或 scope 所属应用不匹配也会触发此错误。

当前代码还会在[授权码换取 token](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go#L896)及[刷新 token](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/e00fbdbbc74f9829027a78769cbeb265d6271fb4/internal/mcpauth/mcpauth.go#L318)时携带 `resource`。因此，本 issue 不把「补齐 scopes」描述为已经验证的完整修复；若仍报错，需要继续核对 resource 映射。
